intents_volume_30d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily NEAR Intents volume, 30 days to asof.

intents_fees_30d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily gross fees (protocol + affiliate), 30 days to asof.

intents_revenue_30d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily revenue captured by NEAR wallets, 30 days to asof.

intents_volume_90d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily NEAR Intents volume, 90 days to asof.

intents_fees_90d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily gross fees (protocol + affiliate), 90 days to asof.

intents_revenue_90d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily revenue captured by NEAR wallets, 90 days to asof.

intents_volume_365d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily NEAR Intents volume, 365 days to asof.

intents_fees_365d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily gross fees (protocol + affiliate), 365 days to asof.

intents_revenue_365d.definition: Sum of DefiLlama daily revenue captured by NEAR wallets, 365 days to asof.

intents_volume_alltime.definition: Sum of the whole DefiLlama daily volume series to asof.

intents_volume_avg_30d.definition: Mean daily volume, 30 days to asof.

intents_volume_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day mean daily volume vs the 30 days ending 365 days earlier.

intents_volume_30d_vs_prev_30d.definition: Last 30 days of volume vs the 30 days before.

intents_share_of_near_dex_volume_30d.definition: Intents volume / all DEX volume DefiLlama attributes to Near, 30 days.

tx_per_day_30d.definition: Mean daily txns, 30 days to asof.

tx_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day mean txns vs the 30 days ending 365 days earlier.

tx_yoy_90d.definition: 90-day mean txns vs the 90 days ending 365 days earlier.

tx_vs_peak_30d.definition: 30-day mean txns vs the highest 30-day mean on record (ending 2025-01-01).

tx_vs_peak_day.definition: txns on asof vs the single highest day (2023-12-01).

active_accounts_per_day_30d.definition: Mean daily active_accounts, 30 days to asof.

active_accounts_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day mean active_accounts vs the 30 days ending 365 days earlier.

active_accounts_yoy_90d.definition: 90-day mean active_accounts vs the 90 days ending 365 days earlier.

active_accounts_vs_peak_30d.definition: 30-day mean active_accounts vs the highest 30-day mean on record (ending 2024-07-09).

active_accounts_vs_peak_day.definition: active_accounts on asof vs the single highest day (2024-04-22).

new_accounts_per_day_30d.definition: Mean daily new_accounts, 30 days to asof.

new_accounts_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day mean new_accounts vs the 30 days ending 365 days earlier.

new_accounts_yoy_90d.definition: 90-day mean new_accounts vs the 90 days ending 365 days earlier.

new_accounts_vs_peak_30d.definition: 30-day mean new_accounts vs the highest 30-day mean on record (ending 2024-07-06).

new_accounts_vs_peak_day.definition: new_accounts on asof vs the single highest day (2023-12-21).

net_issuance_near_30d_rpc.definition: total_supply in block headers: first block of 2026-11-11 minus first block 30 days earlier (archival RPC).

net_inflation_annual_pct_30d_rpc.definition: Net supply growth over 30 days, annualized linearly, from block headers.

net_issuance_near_90d_rpc.definition: total_supply in block headers: first block of 2026-11-11 minus first block 90 days earlier (archival RPC).

net_inflation_annual_pct_90d_rpc.definition: Net supply growth over 90 days, annualized linearly, from block headers.

net_issuance_near_360d_rpc.definition: total_supply in block headers: first block of 2026-11-11 minus first block 360 days earlier (archival RPC).

net_inflation_annual_pct_360d_rpc.definition: Net supply growth over 360 days, annualized linearly, from block headers.

l1_fees_near_30d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee, 30 days.

l1_fees_usd_30d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee_usd, 30 days.

net_issuance_near_30d.definition: NearBlocks daily total_supply on asof minus 30 days earlier.

net_inflation_annual_pct_30d.definition: Net supply growth over 30 days, annualized linearly.

burn_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_30d.definition: L1 fees / net supply growth, 30 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_30d.definition: L1 fees / (net supply growth + fees), 30 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn70_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_30d.definition: As above with 70% of fees burnt, the rule before protocol version 87.

intents_revenue_near_30d.definition: Daily captured revenue / that day's NEAR price, summed over 30 days.

revenue_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_30d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / gross issuance, 30 days.

revenue_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_30d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / net supply growth, 30 days.

usage_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_30d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / gross issuance, 30 days.

usage_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_30d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / net supply growth, 30 days.

fees_cover_of_gross_issuance_usd_pct_30d.definition: Gross Intents fees / gross issuance valued at the asof price, 30 days.

breakeven_multiple_30d.definition: Gross issuance / (captured revenue + L1 fees), 30 days: how many times usage must grow to offset issuance.

intents_fees_over_l1_fees_30d.definition: Gross Intents fees / L1 fees in USD, 30 days.

intents_revenue_over_l1_fees_30d.definition: Captured Intents revenue / L1 fees in USD, 30 days.

l1_fees_near_90d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee, 90 days.

l1_fees_usd_90d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee_usd, 90 days.

net_issuance_near_90d.definition: NearBlocks daily total_supply on asof minus 90 days earlier.

net_inflation_annual_pct_90d.definition: Net supply growth over 90 days, annualized linearly.

burn_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_90d.definition: L1 fees / net supply growth, 90 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_90d.definition: L1 fees / (net supply growth + fees), 90 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn70_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_90d.definition: As above with 70% of fees burnt, the rule before protocol version 87.

intents_revenue_near_90d.definition: Daily captured revenue / that day's NEAR price, summed over 90 days.

revenue_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_90d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / gross issuance, 90 days.

revenue_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_90d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / net supply growth, 90 days.

usage_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_90d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / gross issuance, 90 days.

usage_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_90d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / net supply growth, 90 days.

fees_cover_of_gross_issuance_usd_pct_90d.definition: Gross Intents fees / gross issuance valued at the asof price, 90 days.

breakeven_multiple_90d.definition: Gross issuance / (captured revenue + L1 fees), 90 days: how many times usage must grow to offset issuance.

intents_fees_over_l1_fees_90d.definition: Gross Intents fees / L1 fees in USD, 90 days.

intents_revenue_over_l1_fees_90d.definition: Captured Intents revenue / L1 fees in USD, 90 days.

l1_fees_near_365d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee, 365 days.

l1_fees_usd_365d.definition: Sum of NearBlocks daily txn_fee_usd, 365 days.

net_issuance_near_365d.definition: NearBlocks daily total_supply on asof minus 365 days earlier.

net_inflation_annual_pct_365d.definition: Net supply growth over 365 days, annualized linearly.

burn_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_365d.definition: L1 fees / net supply growth, 365 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_365d.definition: L1 fees / (net supply growth + fees), 365 days. Treats all fees as burnt.

burn70_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_365d.definition: As above with 70% of fees burnt, the rule before protocol version 87.

intents_revenue_near_365d.definition: Daily captured revenue / that day's NEAR price, summed over 365 days.

revenue_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_365d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / gross issuance, 365 days.

revenue_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_365d.definition: Captured Intents revenue in NEAR at daily prices / net supply growth, 365 days.

usage_cover_of_gross_issuance_pct_365d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / gross issuance, 365 days.

usage_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_365d.definition: (Captured revenue + L1 fees) / net supply growth, 365 days.

fees_cover_of_gross_issuance_usd_pct_365.definition: Gross Intents fees / gross issuance valued at the asof price, 365 days.

breakeven_multiple_365d.definition: Gross issuance / (captured revenue + L1 fees), 365 days: how many times usage must grow to offset issuance.

intents_fees_over_l1_fees_365d.definition: Gross Intents fees / L1 fees in USD, 365 days.

intents_revenue_over_l1_fees_365d.definition: Captured Intents revenue / L1 fees in USD, 365 days.

l1_fees_usd_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day L1 fees in USD vs a year earlier.

l1_fees_usd_yoy_90d.definition: 90-day L1 fees in USD vs a year earlier.

l1_fees_near_yoy_30d.definition: 30-day L1 fees in NEAR vs a year earlier.

revenue_wallets_near.definition: NEAR + wNEAR held by the three Intents revenue wallets at the first block of 2026-11-11.

revenue_wallets_min_balance_ratio.definition: Smallest ratio between consecutive samples of total holdings; >= 1 means the total never fell between samples.

revenue_wallets_growth_near_30d.definition: Change in revenue wallet holdings over the 30 days before 2026-11-11.

wallet_growth_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_.definition: Growth of revenue wallet holdings / growth of total supply, both from archival RPC, 30 days.

wallet_growth_over_defillama_revenue_30d.definition: Growth of wallet holdings / DefiLlama captured revenue in NEAR over the same 30 days. 1.0 means all reported revenue is still held.

revenue_wallets_growth_near_90d.definition: Change in revenue wallet holdings over the 90 days before 2026-11-11.

wallet_growth_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_.definition: Growth of revenue wallet holdings / growth of total supply, both from archival RPC, 90 days.

wallet_growth_over_defillama_revenue_90d.definition: Growth of wallet holdings / DefiLlama captured revenue in NEAR over the same 90 days. 1.0 means all reported revenue is still held.

revenue_wallets_growth_near_360d.definition: Change in revenue wallet holdings over the 360 days before 2026-11-11.

wallet_growth_cover_of_net_issuance_pct_.definition: Growth of revenue wallet holdings / growth of total supply, both from archival RPC, 360 days.

wallet_growth_over_defillama_revenue_360.definition: Growth of wallet holdings / DefiLlama captured revenue in NEAR over the same 360 days. 1.0 means all reported revenue is still held.

wallet_cover_pct_first_180d.definition: Wallet growth / supply growth, days 360 to 180 before the snapshot (RPC).

wallet_cover_pct_last_180d.definition: Wallet growth / supply growth, last 180 days (RPC).

growth_multiple_to_offset_issuance_90d.definition: 1 / (90-day wallet cover of net issuance): how many times captured revenue must grow, at constant issuance and price ratio.

years_to_offset_issuance_at_measured_vol.definition: ln(multiple) / ln(1 + g) with g = 57.8% a year. A projection, not a measurement: assumes captured revenue grows at g and issuance in NEAR stays as is.

years_to_offset_issuance_at_half_measure.definition: ln(multiple) / ln(1 + g) with g = 28.9% a year. A projection, not a measurement: assumes captured revenue grows at g and issuance in NEAR stays as is.

years_to_offset_issuance_at_25pct_growth.definition: ln(multiple) / ln(1 + g) with g = 25.0% a year. A projection, not a measurement: assumes captured revenue grows at g and issuance in NEAR stays as is.

price_yoy.definition: Price on asof vs 365 days earlier.

price_yoy_30d_avg.definition: 30-day mean price vs a year earlier.

price_yoy_90d_avg.definition: 90-day mean price vs a year earlier.

market_cap_usd.definition: NearBlocks market cap on asof (circulating supply x price).

validators_current.definition: Length of current_validators in the RPC `validators` response.

staked_share_pct.definition: Sum of current validator stake / total_supply from the latest sampled block header.

validators_to_one_third.definition: Smallest number of validators whose stake exceeds one third of current stake.

max_inflation_rate_pct.definition: max_inflation_rate in the live protocol config.

protocol_version.definition: protocol_version in the live protocol config.
